action_contract.mutations: Planning mutates only current ai_flags and consumes source decision RNG. HP, position, spawned units and final action state are settled by the caller.

known_native_differences: The weighted graph chooses deterministic predecessors; the original raster search consumes RNG for equal-cost predecessor order, so identical source RNG byte and final target ties are not guaranteed.
The first target at an equal score follows native weighted-cost/row-major order; original diamond target visitation order can break equal-score ties differently.
Runtime legal attacks additionally use the native combat rule gate (for blocked story targets and exact item legality); source planner and combat resolver can disagree on such targets.
Map feedback starts the shared divide-by-ten timer at full phase:60 frames for appearance/removal,20 target feedback,400 quake. Original timer32 remainder can shorten each by0..9 frames.
Map PPUMASK emphasis retains exact bit/tick pattern but approximates analog NES color response by0.75 attenuation of the other RGB channels.
Original PPU upload/NMI latency and sub-frame scrolling are outside native Godot playback.
